## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.23

### Settings
- Preserves existing recording settings when opening older configurations and keeps camera options accessible when the integration is not loaded.
- Improves cache-folder validation and confirmation when settings are changed in more than one open form.
- Improves recordings-panel setup and cleanup when the integration loads, reloads, or unloads.

### Recordings Panel
- Preserves paused playback and its position during refreshes, same-recording navigation, and language or time-zone changes.
- Improves recovery from playback errors and prevents delayed requests from reopening recordings after leaving the panel.
- Updates mobile layouts, keyboard controls, and recording dates to follow the selected time zone.
- Shows recording warnings, uncached counts, and partial cache-clearing results more clearly.
- Reports failed recording downloads to callers of the cache action.

### Languages
- Adds translated action names, descriptions, and force-arm messages across all supported languages.
- Improves camera, recording, cache, and connection wording, including missing count and status values.
- Updates panel labels and playback errors when the Home Assistant language changes.
